name: Trigger Identification
description: Conducts a structured cue-routine-reward analysis to identify the triggers behind unwanted habits and the rewards those habits provide. Gathers the user's target habit and context, then produces a trigger analysis worksheet, pattern map, and substitution plan with healthier routines that deliver the same reward. Use when the user asks about understanding why they do a bad habit, identifying habit triggers, breaking a habit loop, cue-routine-reward analysis, or understanding behavior patterns. Do NOT use for addiction assessment or treatment, clinical behavior analysis, or substance dependency.
